Qasam hai aasman ki aur raat ko aane wale ki.
Aur tumhein kya maloom ke woh raat ko aane wala kya hai ?
Ke koi jaan aisi nahin hai jis ki koi nigrani karne wala maujood na ho.
Ab insan ko yeh dekhna chahiye ke use kis cheez se paida kya gaya hai ?
Use ek uchalty hue pani se paida kiya gaya hai.
Jo pith aur seene ki haddiyon ke darmiyan se nikalta hai.
Be-shak woh use dobara paida karne par poori tarah qadir hai.
Jis din tamam posheeda baaton ki jaanch hogi.
To insan ke paas na apna koi zoar hoga na koi madadgar.
Qasam hai baarish bhare aasman ki.
Aur phot parne wali zameen ki.
Ke yeh (quran) ek faisla kin baat hai.
Aur yeh koi mazaq nahin hai.
Be-shak yeh (kafir log) chalein chal rahe hain.
Aur mein bhi apni chaal chal raha hon.
Lihaza (ae payghumbar) tum un kafiron ko dheel do , unhein thore dino apne haal par chhor do .
